title: feat(news): one Wednesday 14:00 run for the model and community posts
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Combined the Wednesday model and community news schedules into one 14:00 run that writes, sends, and saves the model post before the community post. `job=wednesday` runs both manually; `job=models` and `job=community` still run individually. The deliver job keeps both texts in one `posts` artifact, so a failed-job rerun reuses the same texts and skips posts already sent.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears a tiny editor's visor and checks two post cards beside a single clock set to Wednesday 14:00; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants grow around the desk. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, in strictly pixel art style, against a warm cream and soft pastel gradient background with dark purple (#110518) outlines — cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
